lens.payload: {"score": 5, "findings": [{"file": "core/pipeline/runner.sh", "category": "race condition", "severity": "medium", "line": 1842, "message": "The `latest` symlink is dereferenced twice in separate reads: once at line 1842 for issue discovery (through `$_ls_sd/pipeline-state.json`) and again at line 2245 (`readlink -f \"$state_dir/latest\"`) for auto-resume resolution; a concurrent pipeline run that atomically replaces the `latest` symlink between those two reads causes `issue` (governs template and goal lookup) to be sourced from one run's state while `state_dir`, `state_file`, and `_runner_issue` are sourced from a different run's state, producing a cross-run identity mismatch.", "quote": "_ls_issue=\"$(jq -r '.issue // \"\"' \"$_ls_sd/pipeline-state.json\" 2>/dev/null || true)\"", "introduced": true, "fix": "code"}, {"file": "core/pipeline/runner.sh", "category": "logic", "severity": "medium", "line": 3855, "message": "The DSRHYD-2 fail-closed contract (a complete stage with an absent artifact must exit 1) is bypassed when the stage's plugin directory cannot be located or the manifest declares no primary artifact: both cases fall through to `info \"Skipping already-complete stage\"` and `continue` without any artifact check, so a complete stage with a missing artifact is silently skipped rather than causing the required exit 1.", "quote": "if [[ -n \"$_du_plugin_dir\" ]]; then", "introduced": true, "fix": "code"}, {"file": "core/pipeline/runner.sh", "category": "logic", "severity": "medium", "line": 3537, "message": "When `_TPL_CYCLE_STAGES_<id>` is unset or empty, `IFS=',' read -ra _dc_members <<< \"\"` produces a single-element array containing the empty string; the `[[ -z \"$_dc_m\" ]] && continue` guard fires for that element, and the loop exits without verifying any member artifact, so a complete cycle whose stage-list variable is empty is silently skipped instead of triggering exit 1.", "quote": "local _dc_csv=\"${!_dc_stages_var:-}\"", "introduced": true, "fix": "code"}, {"file": "core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh", "category": "logic", "severity": "low", "line": 1235, "message": "`_cycle_state_write_iter_start` does not unset `_ZB_CYCLE_ID` or `_ZB_CYCLE_N` on the failure path: `locked_state_update ... || return 1` short-circuits past the `unset` line, leaving both variables exported with the failed call's values; although callers suppress the error with `|| true`, a subsequent `_cycle_state_jq_write_iter_start` call executed before the next `_cycle_state_write_iter_start` assignment would silently operate on stale IDs.", "quote": "locked_state_update \"$state_file\" \"_cycle_state_jq_write_iter_start\" || return 1\n    unset _ZB_CYCLE_ID _ZB_CYCLE_N", "introduced": true, "fix": "code"}, {"file": "core/pipeline/runner.sh", "category": "logic", "severity": "low", "line": 1739, "message": "In `_runner_from_stage_preflight`, when `_artifact_persist_restore` fails the function warns and continues; the subsequent per-stage artifact loop then immediately finds every pre-target artifact missing and exits 1 with \"has no restorable primary artifact\" for the first stage — an error message that attributes the failure to the stage rather than to the git-layer restore failure that caused it, making the root cause non-obvious.", "quote": "_artifact_persist_restore \"$_fsp_issue\" \"$_fsp_staging\" \\\n        || warn \"from-stage-preflight: git state restore failed for issue=$_fsp_issue — artifact verification may fail\"", "introduced": true, "fix": "code"}]}
